tools.name: get_esim_catalog
tools.description: Queries active travel eSIM data plans. Refines by destination name, country code, or query keywords (e.g. JP, Japan, Europe 10GB, USA 30 Days).

tools.name: get_knowledge_base
tools.description: Retrieves the official ConnectMeGuru grounding knowledge base, including installation guides, device compatibility, refund policies, and support escalation workflows.

tools.name: get_available_coupons
tools.description: Retrieves currently active official ConnectMeGuru promotional coupon codes with their descriptions and applicability.

tools.name: validate_coupon
tools.description: Validates an official promotional discount coupon code for eSIM checkout.

tools.name: get_checkout_url
tools.description: Generates a secure web checkout and purchase link on connectmeguru.com for a specific eSIM package.
